title: AutomationML CAEX 3.0 JSON
description: JSON-first serialization for AutomationML CAEX 3.0. Field names use the canonical AML element and attribute names while SDK models expose readable snake_case Python attributes.

AdditionalInformation.description:
Auxiliary object information.

CAEX 3.0 leaves this element open. The SDK keeps common AutomationML fields
explicit while allowing association-specific extensions.
